description.en:
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack - Breakdown Form

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Stagecraft Form

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form

Consume STA to pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Stagecraft Form

Consume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form

Consume STA to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form

Hold Normal Attack in the air to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter - Stagecraft Form

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Breakdown Form

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack - Breakdown Form

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Stagecraft Form

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form

Mid-air Attack - Stagecraft Form

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form

Tahan Normal Attack di udara untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack dengan biaya STA, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter - Stagecraft Form

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 4.

Dodge Counter - Breakdown Form

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4 atau Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4.

description.en:
Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form

Pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG.

Beckon - Breakdown Form

Pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Banish - Breakdown Form.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Banish - Breakdown Form

While holding a Dark Core, replace Beckon - Breakdown Form with Banish - Breakdown Form.
Cast Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 1 to pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG. Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill shortly after to cast Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2.
Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 consumes all Dark Cores, dealing Fusion DMG. For each Dark Core consumed, the DMG Multiplier of the attack is increased by 150%.
The skill deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Beckon - Breakdown Form.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form

Menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Beckon - Breakdown Form

Menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Banish - Breakdown Form.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Banish - Breakdown Form

Saat memegang Dark Core, Beckon - Breakdown Form digantikan oleh Banish - Breakdown Form.
Lancarkan Banish - Breakdown Form Tahap 1 untuk menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Fusion DMG. Tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill sesaat setelahnya untuk melancarkan Banish - Breakdown Form Tahap 2.
Banish - Breakdown Form Tahap 2 mengonsumsi seluruh Dark Core, memberikan Fusion DMG. Untuk setiap Dark Core yang dikonsumsi, Pengali DMG serangan ini meningkat sebesar 150%.
Skill ini memberikan Resonance Liberation DMG.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Beckon - Breakdown Form.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
Final Act - Stagecraft Form

Deal Fusion DMG.
After performing this skill, obtain Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form for 12s, then switch to Breakdown Form.

Final Act - Breakdown Form

When Conformal Charge is full, consume all Conformal Charge and Void Particle to perform this skill.
Deal Fusion DMG.
After casting this skill, obtain Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form, which lasts for 30s, and then switch to Stagecraft Form.
Can be performed in mid-air.

Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form

Increases ATK by 30%.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect.

Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form

Grants 1 point of Void Particle per second.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect.
description.id:
Final Act - Stagecraft Form

Memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah melakukan skill ini, mendapat Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form selama 12 dtk, lalu berganti ke Breakdown Form.

Final Act - Breakdown Form

Saat Conformal Charge penuh, konsumsi seluruh Conformal Charge dan Void Particle untuk melakukan skill ini.
Memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, mendapat Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form yang berlangsung selama 30 dtk, lalu berganti ke Stagecraft Form.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form

Meningkatkan ATK sebesar 30%.
Mendapat efek ini menghapus efek Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form.

Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form

Memberikan 1 poin Void Particle per detik.
Mendapat efek ini menghapus efek Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form.

description.en: When Denia engages in combat in Stagecraft Form: restore Dark Cores to 2 if she has fewer than 2; restore Void Particle to 20 points if she has fewer than 20. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
description.id: Saat Denia memulai pertarungan dalam Stagecraft Form: memulihkan Dark Core menjadi 2 jika kurang dari 2; memulihkan Void Particle menjadi 20 poin jika kurang dari 20. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 12 dtk.

description.en:
While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current Resonance Mode:
- Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst: All Resonators in the team gain 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: All Resonators in the team gain 10 Tune Break Boost. When a Resonator in the team has an Off-Tune Buildup Rate over 100%, every 10% that runs over increases the Resonator's Tune Break Boost by 8, up to 40.
description.id:
Saat dalam status Entropy Shift, Denia mendapat efek berikut berdasarkan Resonance Mode saat ini:
- Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst: Seluruh Resonator di tim mendapat 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: Seluruh Resonator di tim mendapat 10 Tune Break Boost. Saat Resonator di tim memiliki Off-Tune Buildup Rate di atas 100%, setiap kelebihan 10% meningkatkan Tune Break Boost Resonator tersebut sebesar 8, hingga 40.

description.en:
Erosion Field

After casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, generate an Erosion Field, lasting for 30s. Only one Erosion Field generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.
Erosion Field pulls in nearby targets once every 4s, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Void Particle

When in the Breakdown Form while holding Void Particle, Normal Attack consumes Void Particle on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster.

Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst

While in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict 2 stacks of Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, and Erosion Field.
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to Fusion Burst DMG, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.

Resonance Mode - Tune Strain

While in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target and reset the duration of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, Erosion Field, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3 and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Resonators in the team inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, this target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 50% of the max. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 300s.

Dark Core

- Denia can hold up to 3 Dark Cores.
- While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains 1 Dark Core every 12s.
Denia obtains 1 Dark Core upon casting Intro Skill It's Been A While! and Intro Skill Knock Knock.

Void Particle

- Denia can hold up to 100 points of Void Particle.
- While in Stagecraft Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack grants Void Particle.
- Casting Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form grants 25 points of Void Particle.

Conformal Charge

- Denia can hold up to 100 points of Conformal Charge.
- While in Breakdown Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack or Resonance Skill Beckon - Breakdown Form grants Conformal Charge.
- Casting Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 grants 40 points of Conformal Charge.
description.id:
Erosion Field

Setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, menciptakan Erosion Field yang berlangsung selama 30 dtk. Hanya satu Erosion Field yang diciptakan oleh Resonator milik sendiri yang dapat ada dalam satu waktu.
Erosion Field menarik target di sekitar sekali setiap 4 dtk, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Void Particle

Saat dalam Breakdown Form sambil memegang Void Particle, Normal Attack mengonsumsi Void Particle saat mengenai target dan memberikan efek berikut:
- DMG skill dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG dan Pengali DMG meningkat sebesar 50%.
- Conformal Charge beregenerasi 100% lebih cepat.

Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Denia mendapat efek berikut:
- Setiap kali skill berikut memberikan damage, menimbulkan 2 stack Fusion Burst pada target. Skill yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali setiap 2 dtk pada target yang sama.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, dan Erosion Field.
- Setiap kali skill berikut memberikan damage, menimbulkan Fusion Burst pada target. Skill yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali setiap 2 dtk pada target yang sama.
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, dan Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4.
- Saat Denia berada di tim, jika musuh tumbang oleh Fusion Burst DMG, dihitung sebagai disebabkan oleh Resonator aktif terdekat.

Resonance Mode - Tune Strain

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia mendapat efek berikut:
- Setiap kali skill berikut memberikan damage, menimbulkan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target dan mereset durasi Tune Strain - Interfered pada target. Skill yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali setiap 2 dtk pada target yang sama.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, Erosion Field, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, dan Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4.
- Saat Resonator di tim menimbulkan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target, Off-Tune Level target ini meningkat sebesar 50% dari maksimum. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu pada target yang sama sekali setiap 300 dtk.

Dark Core

- Denia dapat menampung hingga 3 Dark Core.
- Saat dalam status Entropy Shift, Denia mendapat 1 Dark Core setiap 12 dtk.
Denia mendapat 1 Dark Core saat melancarkan Intro Skill It's Been A While! dan Intro Skill Knock Knock.

Void Particle

- Denia dapat menampung hingga 100 poin Void Particle.
- Saat dalam Stagecraft Form, memberikan damage melalui Normal Attack memberikan Void Particle.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, atau Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form memberikan 25 poin Void Particle.

Conformal Charge

- Denia dapat menampung hingga 100 poin Conformal Charge.
- Saat dalam Breakdown Form, memberikan damage melalui Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill Beckon - Breakdown Form memberikan Conformal Charge.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form Tahap 2 memberikan 40 poin Conformal Charge.

description.en:
When in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Fusion Burst DMG against targets near the active Resonator in the team is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends early when Denia switches modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, the incoming Resonator has their All DMG Amplified by 15% for 16s.
After this Resonator under this effect inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, they gain 40% DMG Amplification instead.
This effect ends early when this Resonator is switched out or when Denia switches modes.
description.id:
Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Fusion Burst DMG terhadap target di sekitar Resonator aktif di tim di-Amplify sebesar 60% selama 30 dtk.
Efek ini berakhir lebih awal saat Denia berganti mode.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify All DMG sebesar 15% selama 16 dtk.
Setelah Resonator di bawah efek ini menimbulkan Tune Strain - Shifting, ia mendapat 40% DMG Amplification sebagai gantinya.
Efek ini berakhir lebih awal saat Resonator ini diganti keluar atau saat Denia berganti mode.

description.en:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Denia can cast Tune Break on the target.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Denia can inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.
- Denia can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
When responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Denia's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Denia is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
description.id:
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Denia dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia mendapat efek berikut:
- Denia dapat menimbulkan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target.
- Denia dapat merespons Tune Strain - Interfered.
Saat merespons Tune Strain - Interfered: Untuk setiap stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target, setiap poin Tune Break Boost Denia meningkatkan total DMG-nya terhadap target sebesar 0,12%. Selama Denia berada di tim, batas stack maksimum Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkat sebesar 1.

sequences.name: Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream

description.en:
Crit. DMG is increased by 30%.

When performing Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form, or Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Denia becomes immune to interruption.

When Denia enters combat in Stagecraft Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect for 30s.
When Denia enters combat in Breakdown Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect for 12s.
description.id:
Crit. DMG meningkat sebesar 30%.

Saat melakukan Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form, atau Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 3, dan Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Tahap 4, Denia kebal terhadap interupsi.

Saat Denia memulai pertarungan dalam Stagecraft Form, ia mendapat efek Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form selama 30 dtk.
Saat Denia memulai pertarungan dalam Breakdown Form, ia mendapat efek Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form selama 12 dtk.

sequences.name: Tossed in the Tides of Reality

description.en:
When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, after a Resonator in the team inflicts Fusion Burst on the target, they gain 50% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. After Fusion Burst is triggered on enemies near the active Resonator in the team, Denia gains 1 stacks of Degenerate Voidmatter for 15s, up to 10 stacks. Each stack of Degenerate Voidmatter causes Denia to ignore 1% of the target's Fusion RES.
This effect ends when Denia switches modes.

When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, her Forte Circuit effect is enhanced: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 20 for 15s, and the target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 100% of the max. This effect can only be triggered once per 300s on the same target.
This effect ends when Denia switches forms.

The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form is increased by 40%.
description.id:
Saat Denia berada dalam Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, setelah Resonator di tim menimbulkan Fusion Burst pada target, ia mendapat 50% Fusion DMG Bonus selama 15 dtk. Setelah Fusion Burst dipicu pada musuh di sekitar Resonator aktif di tim, Denia mendapat 1 stack Degenerate Voidmatter selama 15 dtk, hingga 10 stack. Setiap stack Degenerate Voidmatter membuat Denia mengabaikan 1% Fusion RES target.
Efek ini berakhir saat Denia berganti mode.

Saat Denia berada dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, efek Forte Circuit miliknya diperkuat: Setelah Resonator di tim menimbulkan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target, Tune Break Boost-nya meningkat sebesar 20 selama 15 dtk, dan Off-Tune Level target meningkat sebesar 100% dari maksimum. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu sekali per 300 dtk pada target yang sama.
Efek ini berakhir saat Denia berganti wujud.

Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form meningkat sebesar 40%.

sequences.name: Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form is increased by 80%.

Denia now holds up to 5 Dark Cores. While in Entropy Shift, the shortest interval at which she can obtain Dark Core is reduced to 6s.
The Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect is enhanced and now grants 4 points of Void Particle per second.
The Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect is enhanced: Casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy.

Denia's Inherent Skill Vestiges of Falsehood is enhanced:
Upon entering combat, Dark Core and Void Particle are restored to the max. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

When the number of Dark Cores reaches the limit, casting Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4 or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form consumes all Dark Cores and increases the DMG Multiplier of this skill by 1200%. The DMG dealt is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form meningkat sebesar 80%.

Denia kini dapat menampung hingga 5 Dark Core. Saat dalam Entropy Shift, interval tersingkat untuk mendapatkan Dark Core berkurang menjadi 6 dtk.
Efek Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form diperkuat dan kini memberikan 4 poin Void Particle per detik.
Efek Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form diperkuat: Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form juga memulihkan 30 poin Concerto Energy.

Inherent Skill Denia, Vestiges of Falsehood, diperkuat:
Saat memulai pertarungan, Dark Core dan Void Particle dipulihkan hingga maksimum. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 12 dtk.

Saat jumlah Dark Core mencapai batas, melancarkan Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Tahap 4 atau Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form mengonsumsi seluruh Dark Core dan meningkatkan Pengali DMG skill ini sebesar 1200%. DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

sequences.name: From the Far Beyond, to the Far Beyond

description.en: The attack interval of Erosion Field is reduced to 3s.
description.id: Interval serangan Erosion Field berkurang menjadi 3 dtk.

sequences.name: If Lies Patch Up a Heart

description.en: The DMG of Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form is increased by 100%.
description.id: DMG Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form meningkat sebesar 100%.

sequences.name: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence

description.en:
While in Entropy Shift states, gain 60% ATK increase and 60% Fusion DMG Bonus.

While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, after Erosion Field deals damage, trigger Fusion Burst on the target based on its max limit. The Fusion Burst DMG triggered gains a 200% DMG Multiplier increase against the main target and does not remove the Fusion Burst stacks on the targets hit. The effect can be triggered on the same target up to 1 time. When the target is damaged by Resonance Liberation Final Act: Breakdown Form, the effect's trigger count is reset. The trigger count can be reset for the same target once every 2s.

While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, when Resonators in the team deal Tune Break DMG to Mistuned enemies in Tune Strain - Shifting, they additionally inflict 1 stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 3s.
description.id:
Saat dalam status Entropy Shift, mendapat peningkatan ATK sebesar 60% dan 60% Fusion DMG Bonus.

Saat Denia berada dalam Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, setelah Erosion Field memberikan damage, memicu Fusion Burst pada target berdasarkan batas maksimumnya. Fusion Burst DMG yang dipicu mendapat peningkatan Pengali DMG sebesar 200% terhadap target utama dan tidak menghapus stack Fusion Burst pada target yang terkena. Efek ini dapat dipicu pada target yang sama hingga 1 kali. Saat target terkena damage dari Resonance Liberation Final Act: Breakdown Form, jumlah pemicu efek direset. Jumlah pemicu dapat direset untuk target yang sama sekali setiap 2 dtk.

Saat Denia berada dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, ketika Resonator di tim memberikan Tune Break DMG kepada musuh Mistuned yang terkena Tune Strain - Shifting, mereka juga menimbulkan 1 stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu pada target yang sama sekali setiap 3 dtk.
